## Change and reason

Describe the user-visible change or defect and its cause.

## Verification

List relevant checks and any untested boundary. Use synthetic fixtures.

## Provenance

Identify copied/adapted third-party material, sources, licences and notices;
material AI assistance; and any known restrictions. Write “None” where applicable.
Identify other authors and any employer/client ownership that affects authority.

## Contributor agreement

Read the [CAP Contributor Agreement](https://github.com/newtonlorenz/CAP/blob/main/CONTRIBUTOR_AGREEMENT.md). Acceptance is an
affirmative statement from every contributor or an authorised owner representative,
not this prefilled template. Copy the statement from section 6, complete its identity
fields and post it here or in your own comment only if you accept. Maintainers must
record the agreement base commit, final contribution head commit and accepting
accounts before merge. Do not publish confidential authority evidence.
